--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Prime.Basic
theorem exists_dvd_of_not_prime2 {n : ℕ} (n2 : 2 ≤ n) (np : ¬Prime n) :
    ∃ m, m ∣ n ∧ 2 ≤ m ∧ m < n :=
  ⟨minFac n, minFac_dvd _, (minFac_prime (ne_of_gt n2)).two_le,
    (not_prime_iff_minFac_lt n2).1 np⟩

--src: Mathlib.Computability.Partrec
theorem rfind_min' {p : ℕ → Bool} {m : ℕ} (pm : p m) : ∃ n ∈ rfind p, n ≤ m :=
  have : true ∈ (p : ℕ →. Bool) m := ⟨trivial, pm⟩
  let ⟨n, hn⟩ := dom_iff_mem.1 <| (@rfind_dom p).2 ⟨m, this, fun {_} _ => ⟨⟩⟩
  ⟨n, hn, not_lt.1 fun h => by injection mem_unique this (rfind_min hn h)⟩

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Prime.Basic
theorem not_prime_iff_exists_dvd_ne {n : ℕ} (h : 2 ≤ n) : (¬Prime n) ↔ ∃ m, m ∣ n ∧ m ≠ 1 ∧ m ≠ n :=
  ⟨exists_dvd_of_not_prime h, fun ⟨_, h1, h2, h3⟩ => not_prime_of_dvd_of_ne h1 h2 h3⟩

--src: Mathlib.NumberTheory.LucasLehmer
@[simp]
theorem one_lt_mersenne {p : ℕ} : 1 < mersenne p ↔ 1 < p :=
  mersenne_lt_mersenne (p := 1)

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Find
protected theorem find_min : ∀ {m : ℕ}, m < Nat.find H → ¬p m :=
  @(Nat.findX H).2.right

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.PartENat
theorem lt_find (n : ℕ) (h : ∀ m ≤ n, ¬P m) : (n : PartENat) < find P := by
  rw [coe_lt_iff]
  intro h₁
  rw [find_get]
  have h₂ := @Nat.find_spec P _ h₁
  revert h₂
  contrapose!
  exact h _

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Size
theorem lt_size {m n : ℕ} : m < size n ↔ 2 ^ m ≤ n := by
  rw [← not_lt, Decidable.iff_not_comm, not_lt, size_le]

--src: Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Clique
@[simp]
theorem cliqueFree_bot (h : 2 ≤ n) : (⊥ : SimpleGraph α).CliqueFree n := by
  intro t ht
  have := le_trans h (isNClique_bot_iff.1 ht).1
  contradiction

--src: Mathlib.SetTheory.Cardinal.Basic
theorem two_le_iff' (x : α) : (2 : Cardinal) ≤ #α ↔ ∃ y : α, y ≠ x := by
  rw [two_le_iff, ← nontrivial_iff, nontrivial_iff_exists_ne x]

--src: Mathlib.Data.Nat.Prime.Defs
theorem prime_def_minFac {p : ℕ} : Prime p ↔ 2 ≤ p ∧ minFac p = p :=
  ⟨fun pp =>
    ⟨pp.two_le,
      let ⟨f2, fd, _⟩ := minFac_has_prop <| ne_of_gt pp.one_lt
      ((dvd_prime pp).1 fd).resolve_left (ne_of_gt f2)⟩,
    fun ⟨p2, e⟩ => e ▸ minFac_prime (ne_of_gt p2)⟩

id.content:
problem usa2011_p4 :
    match solution_data with
    | .AlwaysTrue => ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → P n
    | .Counterexample m => 2 ≤ m ∧ ¬ P m := by
  -- See https://web.evanchen.cc/exams/USAMO-2011-notes.pdf for an informal proof.
  dsimp
  refine ⟨by norm_num, ?_⟩
  rw [not_exists]
  intro x hx
  rw [show 4 = 2^2 by rfl, ←Nat.pow_mul] at hx

  -- 2^(2^25) is small enough that we can just normalize it.
  rw [show 2 ^ 2 ^ 25 % (2 ^ 25 - 1) = 2 ^ 7 by norm_num] at hx

  have h2 : 2 ≤ 2 := by norm_num
  have h3 := Nat.pow_right_injective h2 hx
  apply_fun (· % 2) at h3
  norm_num at h3

C1_dependencies.name: Nat.pow_right_injective
C1_dependencies.content:
protected lemma pow_right_injective (ha : 2 ≤ a) : Injective (a ^ ·) := by
  simp [Injective, le_antisymm_iff, Nat.pow_le_pow_iff_right ha]

C1_dependencies.name: Nat.pow_mul
C1_dependencies.content:
protected theorem pow_mul (a m n : Nat) : a ^ (m * n) = (a ^ m) ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [Nat.mul_zero, Nat.pow_zero, Nat.pow_zero]
  | succ _ ih => rw [Nat.mul_succ, Nat.pow_add, Nat.pow_succ, ih]
